recipes.name: Protein Overnight Oats
steps: Stir the oats, milk, yoghurt, protein powder and chia seeds together in a jar.
Cover and refrigerate overnight (or at least 4 hours).
Top with berries and a drizzle of honey before eating.

recipes.name: Scrambled Eggs on Toast
steps: Whisk the eggs and milk with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan over low-medium heat and wilt the spinach.
Add the eggs and stir gently until just set.
Serve on toasted wholemeal bread.

recipes.name: Greek Yoghurt Berry Bowl
steps: Spoon the yoghurt into a bowl.
Top with berries, chopped almonds and chia seeds.
Drizzle with honey.

recipes.name: Banana Protein Pancakes
steps: Blend the oats into a flour, then add banana, eggs, egg whites and protein powder and blend until smooth.
Rest the batter for 5 minutes.
Cook ¼-cup portions in a non-stick pan over medium heat, about 2 minutes each side.
Serve with berries and maple syrup.

recipes.name: Veggie Egg Muffins
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C and grease a 6-hole muffin tray (makes 6 large muffins, 2 per serve).
Divide the vegetables and feta between the holes.
Whisk the eggs with salt and pepper and pour over the vegetables.
Bake for 20–22 minutes until set. Keeps 4 days in the fridge.

recipes.name: Avocado Toast with Eggs
steps: Poach or fry the eggs to your liking.
Mash the avocado with lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Spread on toast, top with the eggs and tomatoes.

recipes.name: Chicken & Quinoa Salad
steps: Season the chicken and cook in a hot pan for 5–6 minutes each side until cooked through. Rest, then slice.
Toss the quinoa, spinach, tomatoes and cucumber in a bowl.
Whisk the oil and lemon juice, pour over the salad and toss.
Top with the chicken and crumbled feta.

recipes.name: Tuna Salad Wrap
steps: Mix the tuna with the yoghurt, salt and pepper.
Lay the salad on the wrap, add the tuna and roll up tightly.

recipes.name: Chicken Burrito Bowl
steps: Coat the chicken in taco seasoning and cook in a hot pan for 5–6 minutes each side. Slice.
Warm the rice, beans and corn.
Divide between two bowls with lettuce, salsa, avocado and the chicken.

recipes.name: Lentil & Vegetable Soup
steps: Heat the oil in a large pot and cook the onion, carrot and garlic for 5 minutes.
Add the lentils, tomatoes and 750 ml water or stock. Simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir through the spinach until wilted and season to taste. Freezes well.

recipes.name: Hummus Chicken Wrap
steps: Spread the hummus over the wrap.
Add the spinach, capsicum and chicken, then roll up.

recipes.name: Veggie Egg Fried Rice
steps: Heat the oil in a wok and stir-fry the onion and carrot for 3 minutes.
Add the peas and rice and stir-fry until hot.
Push the rice aside, scramble the eggs in the space, then mix through.
Season with soy sauce.

recipes.name: Honey Soy Chicken Stir-Fry
steps: Mix the soy sauce and honey.
Stir-fry the chicken in hot oil for 5 minutes until browned, then remove.
Stir-fry the garlic and vegetables for 3–4 minutes.
Return the chicken, add the sauce and toss for 1 minute. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Salmon, Sweet Potato & Greens
steps: Toss the sweet potato in half the oil and roast at 200 °C for 25 minutes.
After 10 minutes, add the salmon to the tray, brushed with the remaining oil, garlic and lemon.
Steam the broccoli and serve everything together.

recipes.name: Lean Beef Spaghetti Bolognese
steps: Cook the onion, carrot and garlic in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the mince and brown, breaking it up.
Add the passata, season and simmer for 20 minutes.
Cook the spaghetti, then serve topped with the sauce and parmesan.

recipes.name: Lean Beef Tacos
steps: Brown the mince, add the taco seasoning and a splash of water and simmer for 3 minutes.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with mince, lettuce, salsa, cheese and a spoon of yoghurt.

recipes.name: Thai Red Chicken Curry
steps: Fry the curry paste in a large pan for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the chicken and cook for 5 minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk, add the vegetables and simmer for 10–12 minutes.
Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Garlic Prawn Pasta
steps: Cook the pasta and keep a little of the cooking water.
Fry the garlic in the oil for 1 minute, add the prawns and cook until pink.
Add the tomatoes and spinach for 2 minutes.
Toss through the pasta with lemon juice and a splash of pasta water. Top with parmesan.

recipes.name: Crispy Tofu Noodle Stir-Fry
steps: Pat the tofu dry and pan-fry in the oil until golden on all sides. Remove.
Stir-fry the garlic and vegetables for 4 minutes.
Add the noodles, tofu, soy sauce and honey and toss until hot.

recipes.name: Chicken & Veg Tray Bake
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Toss the potatoes with half the oil and roast for 15 minutes.
Add the chicken, capsicum, onion, garlic and remaining oil. Season and roast for 20 minutes.
Add the broccoli for the last 8 minutes. Great for meal prep.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Banana Rice Cakes
steps: Spread peanut butter on the rice cakes.
Top with banana slices and a drizzle of honey.

recipes.name: Cottage Cheese & Berries
steps: Top the cottage cheese with berries and honey.

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Protein Smoothie
steps: Blend everything with a handful of ice until smooth.

recipes.name: Hummus & Veggie Sticks
steps: Cut the vegetables into sticks and serve with hummus.

recipes.name: Protein Energy Balls
steps: Mix everything in a bowl (add a splash of milk if too dry).
Roll into 12 balls (2 per serve).
Chill for 30 minutes. Keeps a week in the fridge.

recipes.name: Apple & Almonds
steps: Slice the apple and enjoy with the almonds.

recipes.name: Lighter Butter Chicken
steps: Toss the chicken with the yoghurt and half the spices; marinate 10 minutes (or overnight).
Brown the chicken in half the oil in a large pan, then set aside.
Soften the onion, garlic and ginger in the remaining oil, then stir in the rest of the spices for 30 seconds.
Add the passata and simmer 10 minutes.
Return the chicken, stir in the cream and simmer 5 minutes until cooked through.
Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Chickpea & Spinach Curry
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, then add garlic, ginger and spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and chickpeas and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in the coconut milk and spinach until wilted.
Serve with brown rice.

recipes.name: Chicken Tikka Skewers
steps: Mix the chicken with 80 g of the yoghurt, the spices and lemon juice.
Thread onto skewers with capsicum and onion.
Grill or air-fry at 200 °C for 12–15 minutes, turning once.
Grate the cucumber into the remaining yoghurt for a quick raita.
Serve with salad leaves and the raita.

recipes.name: Red Lentil Dal
steps: Fry the onion in the oil until soft, then add garlic, ginger and spices.
Add lentils, tomatoes and stock; simmer 15–20 minutes until thick.
Stir through the spinach.
Serve with brown rice.

recipes.name: Masala Omelette
steps: Whisk the eggs with the spices and a pinch of salt.
Stir in onion, tomato, spinach and coriander.
Cook in the oiled pan over medium heat until set, then fold.
Serve with toast.

recipes.name: Protein Mango Lassi
steps: Blend everything until smooth.
Add ice if you like it colder.

recipes.name: Teriyaki Chicken Bowl
steps: Pan-fry the chicken in the sesame oil, 5 minutes each side.
Add the teriyaki sauce and cook until sticky; slice.
Steam the broccoli and edamame.
Build bowls with rice, chicken, vegetables and carrot.

recipes.name: Salmon Poke Bowl
steps: Toss the salmon with soy sauce and sesame oil.
Divide the rice between bowls.
Top with salmon, edamame, cucumber, avocado and carrot.

recipes.name: Miso Soup with Tofu
steps: Bring the stock to a gentle simmer and add mushrooms and bok choy for 2 minutes.
Turn off the heat and whisk in the miso (don't boil it).
Add tofu and noodles and warm through.

recipes.name: Tamagoyaki Breakfast Plate
steps: Whisk eggs with soy sauce and honey.
Pour a thin layer into an oiled pan, roll up when set, push to the side and repeat.
Slice the rolled omelette and serve with rice and edamame.

recipes.name: Salted Edamame
steps: Boil or microwave the edamame for 3–4 minutes.
Sprinkle with sea salt.

recipes.name: Beef Bibimbap
steps: Brown the beef in half the sesame oil with the soy sauce.
Quickly sauté the spinach, carrot and sprouts separately.
Fry the eggs sunny-side up.
Arrange rice, beef, vegetables and egg in bowls; top with gochujang and mix before eating.

recipes.name: Korean Pork Lettuce Wraps
steps: Cook the pork with garlic and ginger until browned.
Stir in gochujang and soy sauce.
Spoon pork and a little rice into lettuce cups and top with carrot and cucumber.

recipes.name: Kimchi Fried Rice
steps: Fry the tofu in the sesame oil until golden.
Add kimchi and gochujang for 2 minutes, then the rice; stir-fry until hot.
Top with fried eggs and spring onion.

recipes.name: Kimchi Tofu Stew
steps: Sauté the kimchi in sesame oil for 2 minutes.
Add stock, gochujang and mushrooms; simmer 10 minutes.
Add tofu chunks and crack in the eggs; simmer 3 minutes.
Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Thai Basil Chicken (Pad Kra Pao)
steps: Stir-fry garlic in the oil for 30 seconds, then add the chicken and cook through.
Add capsicum, fish sauce, soy and honey.
Toss in the basil until wilted.
Serve with rice (and a fried egg if you like).

recipes.name: Thai Beef Salad
steps: Sear the steak 3–4 minutes each side, rest, then slice thinly.
Whisk lime, fish sauce and honey for the dressing.
Toss the salad vegetables and herbs with the beef and dressing.
Top with crushed peanuts.

recipes.name: Chicken Pad Thai
steps: Stir-fry the chicken in the oil until cooked.
Push aside and scramble the eggs.
Add noodles, fish sauce, lime and honey; toss well.
Add sprouts and spring onion; serve topped with peanuts.

recipes.name: Chicken Pho
steps: Simmer the stock with ginger, onion and spices for 15 minutes.
Poach the chicken in the broth for 10–12 minutes, then shred.
Strain the broth and season with fish sauce.
Pour over noodles and chicken; top with sprouts, herbs and lime.

recipes.name: Prawn Rice Paper Rolls
steps: Soften each rice paper sheet in warm water for 10 seconds.
Fill with prawns, noodles, vegetables and mint and roll tightly.
Whisk peanut butter, soy, lime and a splash of hot water for the dipping sauce.

recipes.name: Lemongrass Chicken Noodle Salad
steps: Marinate the chicken in lemongrass, garlic, half the fish sauce and honey.
Grill 5–6 minutes each side and slice.
Mix remaining fish sauce with lime juice for the dressing.
Serve over noodles and salad, topped with herbs and peanuts.

recipes.name: Vietnamese Shaking Beef Bowl
steps: Marinate the beef in garlic, soy, fish sauce and honey for 10 minutes.
Sear in a very hot oiled pan, shaking, 2–3 minutes.
Toss in onion for 1 minute.
Serve over rice with greens and tomatoes.

recipes.name: Breakfast Burrito
steps: Sauté the capsicum and spinach, then add beans to warm.
Scramble the eggs.
Fill the wraps with eggs, beans, vegetables, cheese and salsa; roll and toast in the pan.

recipes.name: Chicken Fajitas
steps: Toss the chicken with seasoning and oil.
Sear in a hot pan, then add capsicum and onion and cook until charred.
Squeeze over lime.
Serve in warm wraps with yoghurt and salsa.

recipes.name: Bean & Cheese Quesadilla
steps: Mix the mashed beans with corn, capsicum and seasoning.
Spread over half of each wrap, add cheese and fold.
Toast in a dry pan 2–3 minutes each side.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.

recipes.name: Huevos Rancheros
steps: Soften the onion, add spices, tomatoes and beans; simmer 8 minutes.
Make wells and crack in the eggs; cover and cook until set.
Serve on toasted tortillas with avocado and coriander.

recipes.name: Chicken Cacciatore
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil and set aside.
Sauté onion, capsicum, mushroom and garlic.
Add tomatoes, herbs, olives and the chicken; simmer covered 30 minutes.
Serve with boiled or roasted potatoes.

recipes.name: Minestrone
steps: Soften the onion and carrot in the oil.
Add stock, tomatoes, zucchini and beans; simmer 15 minutes.
Add the pasta and cook until tender, then stir in spinach.
Serve topped with parmesan.

recipes.name: Protein Margherita Flatbread
steps: Spread passata over the pita and top with mozzarella and tomatoes.
Bake at 220 °C for 8–10 minutes.
Finish with basil and rocket.

recipes.name: Ricotta Berry Toast
steps: Toast the bread.
Spread with ricotta, top with berries and drizzle with honey.

recipes.name: Chicken Souvlaki Plate
steps: Marinate the chicken in lemon, oregano, garlic and oil for 15 minutes.
Thread on skewers and grill 10–12 minutes, turning.
Grate half the cucumber into the yoghurt for tzatziki.
Serve with warm pita, tzatziki, tomato and remaining cucumber.

recipes.name: Greek Chickpea Salad
steps: Chop the vegetables and combine with chickpeas and olives.
Dress with oil, lemon and oregano.
Crumble over the feta.

recipes.name: Greek Baked Fish
steps: Roast the potato chunks at 200 °C for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile soften onion, garlic and zucchini; add tomatoes and olives.
Pour into the tray, nestle in the fish and bake 12–15 minutes.
Scatter with herbs.

recipes.name: Tuna Tzatziki Pita
steps: Grate the cucumber into the yoghurt with lemon for quick tzatziki.
Fill the pita with lettuce, tuna, tomato and tzatziki.

recipes.name: Shakshuka
steps: Soften onion and capsicum in the oil, add garlic and spices.
Add tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes.
Make wells, crack in eggs, cover and cook 5–7 minutes.
Top with feta and serve with toast.

recipes.name: Chicken Shawarma Bowl
steps: Toss chicken with spice, lemon and oil.
Roast at 210 °C for 20–25 minutes, then slice.
Serve over quinoa with chopped salad and hummus.

recipes.name: Lamb Kofta with Tabbouleh
steps: Mix the lamb with onion, spices and half the herbs; shape into 9 koftas.
Grill or pan-fry 8–10 minutes, turning.
Toss quinoa with chopped tomato, cucumber, remaining herbs and lemon.
Serve with yoghurt.

recipes.name: Crunchy Roasted Chickpeas
steps: Toss the chickpeas with oil and spices.
Roast at 200 °C for 25–30 minutes, shaking halfway, until crunchy.

recipes.name: Beef & Broccoli
steps: Stir-fry the beef in half the oil until browned; remove.
Stir-fry broccoli, garlic and ginger in the rest with a splash of water.
Return beef with soy and honey; toss until glossy.
Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Ginger Soy Steamed Fish
steps: Place fish on a plate, top with ginger and steam 8–10 minutes.
Steam the bok choy alongside for the last 3 minutes.
Drizzle with soy and hot sesame oil; scatter spring onion.
Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Chicken Congee
steps: Simmer the rice with stock and ginger for 30 minutes, stirring, until creamy.
Poach the chicken in it for the last 12 minutes, then shred back in.
Season with soy and top with spring onion and sesame oil.

recipes.name: Turkey Burgers
steps: Mix the turkey, onion and egg with salt and pepper; shape 4 patties.
Pan-fry or grill 5 minutes each side until cooked through; add cheese at the end.
Serve in toasted buns with lettuce and tomato.

recipes.name: Lighter Chicken Caesar
steps: Grill the chicken and slice.
Toast the bread cubes until crisp.
Whisk yoghurt, lemon, garlic and half the parmesan for the dressing.
Toss lettuce with dressing; top with chicken, eggs, croutons and remaining parmesan.

recipes.name: Chocolate Protein Mug Cake
steps: Mix everything in a large mug until smooth.
Microwave 60–90 seconds until just set.

recipes.name: Oven Barramundi & Chips
steps: Toss the wedges in two-thirds of the oil and roast at 220 °C for 30 minutes.
Pan-fry the barramundi skin-side down in the rest of the oil, 4 minutes, then 2 minutes on the other side.
Serve with lemon, salad and yoghurt tartare.

recipes.name: Weet-Bix Protein Bowl
steps: Crumble the Weet-Bix into a bowl and pour over the milk.
Top with sliced banana and a dollop of yoghurt.

recipes.name: Sweet & Sour Chicken
steps: Make the sauce: whisk the pineapple juice, vinegar, tomato paste, brown sugar, soy and cornflour slurry in a jug (keep the pineapple pieces aside).
Toss the chicken in the cornflour and stir-fry in the oil over high heat until golden, about 6 minutes.
Add the onion and capsicum and cook 2 minutes more, then the pineapple pieces.
Pour in the sauce and bubble for 1–2 minutes until glossy and thick.
Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Kung Pao Chicken
steps: Make the sauce: mix the soy, vinegar, sugar and cornflour with 3 tbsp water.
Stir-fry the chicken in the oil over high heat for 5 minutes until browned.
Add the chillies, garlic, ginger and capsicum for 1 minute.
Pour in the sauce and toss until it thickens, then add the peanuts and spring onion.
Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Char Siu Pork Fillet
steps: Make the glaze: mix the honey, soy, tomato paste, five spice and garlic.
Coat the pork in half the glaze and leave for 10 minutes (or overnight).
Roast at 200 °C for 20–25 minutes, brushing with the remaining glaze twice, until sticky and cooked through. Rest 5 minutes.
Steam the bok choy for 3 minutes.
Slice the pork and serve with rice and bok choy.

recipes.name: Honey Garlic Prawns
steps: Make the sauce: whisk the honey, soy, garlic, vinegar and cornflour with 2 tbsp water.
Stir-fry the prawns in the oil for 2 minutes until just pink, then add the snow peas for 1 minute.
Pour in the sauce and toss for 1 minute until sticky.
Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Mapo Tofu
steps: Make the sauce base: fry the bean paste, chilli, garlic, ginger and Sichuan pepper in the oil for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the pork and cook until browned, then pour in the stock and soy.
Slide in the tofu and simmer gently for 5 minutes.
Stir in the cornflour slurry to thicken and finish with spring onion.
Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Salmon with Homemade Teriyaki
steps: Make the teriyaki: simmer the soy, mirin, honey, ginger and cornflour (mixed with 2 tbsp water) for 2 minutes until syrupy.
Pan-fry the salmon skin-side down for 4 minutes, flip and cook 2 minutes more.
Pour over half the teriyaki and spoon it over the fish as it bubbles.
Steam the broccoli. Serve with rice, the remaining sauce and sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Baked Chicken Katsu Curry
steps: Make the curry sauce: soften the onion and carrot in the butter for 8 minutes, stir in the flour and curry powder for 1 minute, then whisk in the stock, honey and soy. Simmer 15 minutes and blend smooth if you like.
Meanwhile dust the chicken in flour, dip in egg and press into the panko.
Spray with oil and bake at 220 °C for 18–20 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Slice the katsu and serve over rice with the curry sauce and shredded cabbage.

recipes.name: Cold Soba with Sesame Dressing
steps: Make the dressing: whisk the tahini, soy, vinegar, honey and sesame oil with 1–2 tbsp water until pourable.
Cook the soba per the packet, rinse under cold water and drain well.
Toss the noodles with the edamame, cucumber and carrot.
Pour over the dressing and top with spring onion.

recipes.name: Yaki Udon
steps: Make the sauce: stir together the soy, mirin, oyster sauce and Worcestershire.
Stir-fry the chicken in the oil for 4 minutes, then the vegetables for 3 minutes.
Loosen the udon in hot water, drain and add to the wok.
Pour over the sauce and toss for 2 minutes until coated.

recipes.name: Chicken Satay with Peanut Sauce
steps: Make the marinade: toss the chicken with the soy, spices and honey; thread onto skewers.
Make the peanut sauce: warm the peanut butter, coconut milk, soy, lime, sugar and chilli in a small pan, stirring until smooth.
Grill or air-fry the skewers at 200 °C for 10–12 minutes, turning once.
Serve with rice, cucumber and the warm satay sauce.

recipes.name: Chicken Larb Lettuce Cups
steps: Make the dressing: stir the lime juice, fish sauce, sugar and chilli until dissolved.
Toast the raw rice in a dry pan until golden, then crush to a powder.
Cook the chicken mince with a splash of water, breaking it up, until cooked through.
Off the heat, toss with the dressing, onion, herbs and toasted rice.
Spoon into lettuce cups.

recipes.name: Green Curry with Homemade Paste
steps: Make the curry paste: blitz the lemongrass, chillies, garlic, ginger, coriander, lime, spices and fish sauce to a paste.
Fry the paste in a dry pot for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the coconut milk and 100 ml water and bring to a simmer.
Add the chicken and simmer 6 minutes, then the beans and zucchini for 4 minutes.
Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Prawn Pad Thai
steps: Make the sauce: stir the fish sauce, sugar, lime, vinegar and chilli until the sugar dissolves.
Stir-fry the prawns in the oil for 2 minutes, push aside and scramble the eggs.
Add the noodles and sauce and toss for 2 minutes.
Fold through sprouts and spring onion; top with peanuts and extra lime.

recipes.name: Beef Bulgogi
steps: Make the marinade: mix the soy, sugar, sesame oil, garlic, ginger and grated apple.
Toss the beef and onion in the marinade for at least 15 minutes.
Cook in a very hot pan in batches for 2–3 minutes until caramelised.
Serve over rice with spring onion and sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Gochujang-Glazed Chicken Thighs
steps: Make the glaze: whisk the gochujang, honey, soy, garlic and vinegar.
Bake the chicken at 210 °C for 15 minutes.
Brush thickly with the glaze and bake 8–10 minutes more until sticky and charred at the edges.
Serve with rice, smashed cucumber and sesame seeds.

recipes.name: Japchae Glass Noodles

ingredients.label: cooked sweet potato or rice noodles

steps: Make the sauce: mix the soy, sugar, sesame oil and garlic.
Pan-fry the tofu in the oil until golden; set aside.
Stir-fry the onion, carrot and mushrooms for 3 minutes, then wilt the spinach.
Add the noodles, tofu and sauce and toss until glossy.

recipes.name: Lemongrass Pork Noodle Bowl
steps: Make the marinade: combine the lemongrass, garlic, fish sauce, sugar and oil; toss the pork through for 15 minutes.
Make the nuoc cham: stir the fish sauce, lime, sugar, chilli and garlic with 60 ml warm water.
Grill or pan-fry the pork over high heat for 2 minutes per side.
Build bowls of noodles, lettuce, carrot, cucumber and herbs; top with pork and peanuts and spoon over the nuoc cham.

recipes.name: Banh Mi Chicken Rolls
steps: Make the quick pickle: toss the carrot with the vinegar, sugar and a pinch of salt; leave 15 minutes.
Make the marinade and coat the chicken, then grill 5–6 minutes per side. Rest and slice.
Make the sauce: mix the mayo and chilli.
Split the rolls, spread with chilli mayo and fill with chicken, drained pickle, cucumber and coriander.

recipes.name: Nasi Goreng
steps: Make the sambal sauce: blitz or finely chop the chillies, garlic, shallots and tomato paste; mix the soy and sugar separately.
Fry the sambal in the oil for 2 minutes, add the chicken and cook through.
Add the rice and the soy mixture and stir-fry until hot and caramelised.
Top each serve with a fried egg and add cucumber and tomato on the side.

recipes.name: Gado Gado with Peanut Sauce
steps: Make the peanut sauce: blend the peanut butter, soy, lime, sugar, chilli and garlic with 80 ml hot water until smooth.
Boil the potatoes and eggs; blanch the beans and cabbage.
Pan-fry the tofu until golden.
Arrange everything on a platter and pour over the peanut sauce.

recipes.name: Beef Rendang
steps: Make the curry paste: blitz the onion, garlic, ginger, lemongrass, chillies and spices with a splash of water.
Fry the paste in a heavy pot for 5 minutes until darkened.
Add the beef, coconut milk, sugar and 200 ml water; simmer covered for 1½ hours.
Uncover, stir in the toasted coconut and cook until the sauce is thick and clings to the beef.
Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Chicken Adobo
steps: Make the adobo sauce: combine the vinegar, soy, garlic, sugar, peppercorns and bay leaves with 125 ml water.
Simmer the chicken in the sauce, covered, for 25 minutes.
Lift the chicken out and brown it in a hot pan; reduce the sauce by half.
Return the chicken to the glossy sauce. Serve with rice and steamed beans.

recipes.name: Pesto Chicken Pasta
steps: Make the pesto: blitz the basil, pine nuts, parmesan, garlic and lemon, then drizzle in the oil with 2 tbsp water until smooth.
Cook the pasta; reserve a cup of the cooking water.
Pan-fry the chicken in a non-stick pan until golden and cooked through.
Toss the pasta with the chicken, tomatoes, spinach and pesto, loosening with pasta water.

recipes.name: Turkey Meatballs in Marinara
steps: Make the marinara: soften the onion and garlic in the oil for 6 minutes, add the passata and simmer 15 minutes; stir in torn basil.
Mix the turkey, breadcrumbs, egg and half the parmesan; roll into 20 balls.
Bake the meatballs at 200 °C for 15 minutes, then simmer in the sauce for 5 minutes.
Serve over spaghetti with the remaining parmesan.

recipes.name: Gnocchi Pomodoro
steps: Make the sauce: sizzle the garlic and chilli in the oil, add the tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes; season and add basil.
Boil the gnocchi until they float, then drain.
Toss the gnocchi and spinach through the sauce, top with mozzarella and grill until bubbling.

recipes.name: Lemon Caper Fish Piccata
steps: Dust the fish in flour and pan-fry in half the butter for 3 minutes each side; set aside.
Make the sauce: in the same pan add the garlic, stock and lemon juice and reduce by half, then swirl in the remaining butter, capers and parsley.
Serve the fish with potatoes and beans, spooning over the sauce.

recipes.name: Caprese Chicken with Balsamic Glaze
steps: Make the glaze: simmer the balsamic and honey for 5–6 minutes until it coats a spoon.
Sear the chicken in the oil for 3 minutes each side, top with tomato and mozzarella and bake at 200 °C for 12 minutes.
Serve with roast potatoes and rocket, drizzled with the glaze and basil.

recipes.name: Chicken Souvlaki with Tzatziki
steps: Make the marinade: mix the lemon, oil, garlic and oregano and coat the chicken for 15 minutes; thread onto skewers.
Make the tzatziki: stir the yoghurt, cucumber, garlic, lemon and herbs together.
Grill the skewers 10–12 minutes, turning.
Serve in warm pitas with tomato, onion and lots of tzatziki.

recipes.name: Greek Lemon Chicken & Potatoes
steps: Make the marinade: whisk the lemon, garlic, oil, oregano and stock.
Toss the chicken and potatoes in a roasting tray with the marinade.
Roast at 200 °C for 50 minutes, turning once, until golden and the liquid is mostly absorbed.
Serve with salad.

recipes.name: Baked Fish Plaki
steps: Make the sauce: soften the onion and garlic in the oil, add the tomatoes and herbs and simmer 10 minutes.
Lay the fish in a baking dish, pour over the sauce and lemon juice.
Bake at 190 °C for 15–18 minutes.
Serve with bread and salad.

recipes.name: Spanish Chicken & Smoky Paprika Rice
steps: Make the rub: mix the paprika, turmeric, garlic and oil and rub over the chicken.
Brown the chicken in a wide pan, then add the onion and capsicum for 3 minutes.
Stir in the rice, tomatoes and stock. Simmer without stirring for 20 minutes.
Scatter over the peas, cover and rest 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Prawns with Romesco
steps: Make the romesco: blitz the capsicum, almonds, garlic, vinegar, oil, tomato paste and paprika until smooth.
Roast the potatoes at 220 °C for 25 minutes.
Grill or pan-fry the prawns for 2 minutes each side.
Spread romesco on plates, top with potatoes, prawns and rocket.

recipes.name: Patatas Bravas with Eggs
steps: Roast the potatoes in the oil at 220 °C for 30 minutes until crisp.
Make the bravas sauce: simmer the passata, paprika, chilli, vinegar and garlic for 8 minutes.
Make the yoghurt aioli: stir the yoghurt, garlic and lemon together.
Top the potatoes with bravas sauce, aioli and fried eggs.

recipes.name: Creamy Chicken Dijon
steps: Sear the chicken in the oil 5 minutes each side; set aside.
Make the sauce: brown the mushrooms and garlic, add the stock, mustard and thyme and simmer 3 minutes, then stir in the cream.
Return the chicken and simmer 5 minutes until cooked through.
Serve with potatoes and beans.

recipes.name: Steak with Peppercorn Sauce
steps: Bake the wedges at 220 °C for 30 minutes.
Sear the steaks in the oil to your liking, then rest.
Make the sauce: toast the peppercorns in the pan, add the stock, mustard and Worcestershire and reduce by half, then stir in the cream.
Grill the asparagus and serve everything with the sauce.

recipes.name: Tuna Niçoise with Dijon Vinaigrette
steps: Make the vinaigrette: shake the oil, vinegar, mustard, garlic and honey in a jar.
Boil the potatoes and eggs; blanch the beans.
Arrange everything on plates and drizzle with vinaigrette.

recipes.name: Chicken Tagine with Dates

ingredients.label: ras el hanout (cumin, cinnamon, coriander, paprika)

steps: Make the spice rub: mix the spices, garlic, ginger and oil; coat the chicken.
Brown the chicken, then soften the onion in the same pot.
Add the tomatoes, chickpeas, dates and stock; cover and simmer 30 minutes.
Serve over couscous.

recipes.name: Chermoula Fish with Couscous
steps: Make the chermoula: blitz the herbs, garlic, spices, lemon, oil and chilli.
Coat the fish in half the chermoula.
Roast the vegetables at 220 °C for 15 minutes, add the fish and roast 10 minutes more.
Serve over couscous with the remaining chermoula.

recipes.name: Harira Lentil & Chickpea Soup
steps: Make the spice base: fry the garlic and spices in the oil for 1 minute.
Add the onion and celery and soften 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, stock, lentils and chickpeas and simmer 25 minutes.
Stir in the herbs and lemon; serve with bread.

recipes.name: Turkish Eggs (Çılbır)
steps: Make the yoghurt sauce: stir the garlic into the yoghurt with a pinch of salt and let it come to room temperature.
Make the topping: melt the butter with the chilli until foaming.
Poach the eggs for 3 minutes.
Spread yoghurt on plates, add the eggs, drizzle with chilli butter and dill. Serve with toast.

recipes.name: Lamb Adana Skewers with Garlic Yoghurt
steps: Mix the lamb, onion, spices and parsley; mould around skewers.
Make the garlic yoghurt: stir the yoghurt, garlic, lemon and mint.
Grill the skewers 8–10 minutes, turning.
Serve with pitas, tomato, lettuce and garlic yoghurt.

recipes.name: Chicken Shawarma with Tahini Sauce
steps: Make the marinade and coat the chicken for at least 20 minutes.
Make the tahini sauce: whisk the tahini, lemon and garlic with 3–4 tbsp cold water until creamy.
Roast the chicken at 220 °C for 20 minutes, then slice.
Fill pitas with chicken, salad and tahini sauce.

recipes.name: Baked Falafel Bowl with Lemon Tahini
steps: Pulse the chickpeas, onion, herbs, spices and flour into a coarse mix; roll into 16 patties.
Brush with oil and bake at 200 °C for 25 minutes, turning once.
Make the dressing: whisk the tahini, lemon and garlic with water until drizzly.
Build bowls with quinoa, salad and falafel; drizzle with dressing.

recipes.name: Fattoush with Grilled Halloumi
steps: Make the dressing: whisk the oil, lemon, molasses, sumac and garlic.
Grill the halloumi 1–2 minutes each side.
Toss the salad with the pita and dressing; top with halloumi.

recipes.name: Chicken Tinga Tacos
steps: Poach the chicken in simmering water for 15 minutes, then shred.
Make the tinga sauce: soften the onion and garlic in the oil, add the spices, tomatoes and vinegar and simmer 10 minutes; blend if you like it smooth.
Stir the chicken through the sauce.
Serve in warm tortillas with cabbage, avocado and lime.

recipes.name: Fish Tacos with Lime Crema & Pico
steps: Make the pico de gallo: combine the tomato, onion, coriander, lime and chilli with a pinch of salt.
Make the crema: stir the yoghurt, lime and garlic.
Rub the fish with the spices and oil and pan-fry 3 minutes each side; flake.
Fill tortillas with cabbage, fish, pico and crema.

recipes.name: Black Bean & Sweet Potato Enchiladas
steps: Make the enchilada sauce: fry the garlic and spices in the oil for 30 seconds, add the passata and stock and simmer 10 minutes.
Mix the beans, sweet potato and onion with a third of the sauce.
Roll the filling in the tortillas and lay in a dish.
Pour over the remaining sauce, scatter cheese and bake at 190 °C for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Steak Fajitas
steps: Make the fajita rub: mix the spices, sugar, garlic, oil and lime; toss the beef through.
Char the capsicum and onion in a very hot pan for 5 minutes; set aside.
Sear the beef 2–3 minutes and return the veg.
Serve in warm wraps with sour cream and salsa.

recipes.name: BBQ Pulled Chicken Burgers
steps: Make the BBQ sauce: simmer the tomato paste, vinegar, sugar, Worcestershire, spices and garlic with 125 ml water for 5 minutes.
Simmer the chicken in the sauce, covered, for 20 minutes, then shred with two forks.
Make the slaw: toss the cabbage with the yoghurt, vinegar and mustard.
Pile the chicken and slaw into toasted buns.

recipes.name: Buffalo Chicken Wraps with Yoghurt Ranch
steps: Make the buffalo sauce: whisk the hot sauce, vinegar, melted butter and garlic.
Make the ranch: stir the yoghurt, herbs, garlic and lemon.
Pan-fry the chicken until cooked, then toss in the buffalo sauce.
Fill wraps with lettuce, celery, carrot, chicken and ranch.

recipes.name: Honey Mustard Chicken Traybake
steps: Make the glaze: whisk the honey, mustard, garlic and oil.
Roast the sweet potato at 210 °C for 15 minutes.
Add the chicken and broccoli, pour over the glaze and roast 18–20 minutes more.

recipes.name: Beef Burgers with Special Sauce
steps: Make the special sauce: mix the mayo, tomato paste, vinegar, mustard, sugar and capers.
Shape the beef into 4 patties and season.
Grill or pan-fry 3–4 minutes each side, adding cheese for the last minute.
Build burgers with sauce, lettuce, tomato and onion.

recipes.name: Breakfast Burritos with Fresh Salsa
steps: Make the salsa: mix the tomato, onion, coriander, lime and chilli.
Scramble the eggs and whites with the spinach.
Warm the beans.
Fill the wraps with egg, beans, cheese and salsa; roll and toast seam-side down. Freeze extras.

recipes.name: Steak with Chimichurri
steps: Make the chimichurri: finely chop the parsley and garlic and stir with the vinegar, oil, chilli, oregano and 2 tbsp water.
Roast the potatoes at 220 °C for 30 minutes.
Sear the steak to your liking and rest 5 minutes.
Slice the steak and serve with potatoes and salad, spooning over chimichurri.

recipes.name: Moqueca Fish & Prawn Stew
steps: Squeeze the lime over the fish and season.
Make the sauce: soften the onion, capsicum and garlic in the oil, add paprika, tomatoes and coconut milk and simmer 8 minutes.
Add the fish and prawns and simmer gently for 6 minutes.
Scatter with coriander and serve with rice.

recipes.name: Black Bean & Pork Feijoada
steps: Brown the pork and bacon, then soften the onion and garlic.
Add the beans, stock and spices and simmer 40 minutes, mashing some beans to thicken.
Make the farofa topping: toast the crumbs in the butter until golden.
Wilt the kale. Serve the stew with rice, kale, orange slices and farofa.

recipes.name: Peruvian Chicken with Aji Verde
steps: Make the marinade, coat the chicken and leave 20 minutes.
Make the aji verde: blitz the coriander, jalapeño, yoghurt, mayo, lime, garlic and parmesan until smooth.
Roast the chicken and sweet potato at 210 °C for 30 minutes.
Serve with salad and plenty of aji verde.

recipes.name: Prawn Ceviche Tostadas
steps: Bake the tortillas at 200 °C for 8 minutes until crisp.
Make the ceviche salsa: combine the lime, onion, chilli, coriander, tomato and cucumber.
Fold the prawns through and leave 10 minutes.
Pile onto tostadas with avocado.

recipes.name: Jerk Chicken with Pineapple Salsa
steps: Make the jerk marinade: blitz everything in the marinade list and coat the chicken (ideally overnight).
Make the pineapple salsa: mix the pineapple, onion, coriander, lime and chilli.
Grill or roast the chicken at 220 °C for 20–25 minutes until charred.
Stir the warmed kidney beans through the rice. Serve with the chicken and salsa.

recipes.name: Kangaroo with Balsamic Beetroot
steps: Make the glaze: simmer the balsamic and honey until syrupy.
Roast the beetroot and sweet potato in the oil at 210 °C for 30 minutes; toss in half the glaze.
Sear the kangaroo 3 minutes each side (keep it rare to medium) and rest 5 minutes.
Slice and serve over the veg and rocket with feta and the remaining glaze.

recipes.name: Lamb Steaks with Fresh Mint Sauce
steps: Make the mint sauce: dissolve the sugar in 2 tbsp boiling water, then stir in the vinegar and mint and leave 15 minutes.
Roast the potatoes at 220 °C for 30 minutes.
Sear the lamb 3 minutes each side and rest.
Serve with potatoes, peas and mint sauce.

recipes.name: Oven Fish & Chips with Tartare
steps: Toss the chips in the oil and bake at 220 °C for 35 minutes.
Dip the fish in egg, coat in panko and bake on the top shelf for the last 15 minutes.
Make the tartare: mix the yoghurt, mayo, capers, herbs and lemon.
Serve with salad and lemon wedges.

recipes.name: Lighter Chicken Parmi
steps: Make the napoli sauce: simmer the passata, garlic and herbs for 10 minutes.
Crumb the chicken (flour, egg, crumbs), spray with oil and bake at 220 °C for 15 minutes.
Top with sauce, ham and mozzarella and bake 8 minutes more.
Serve with oven chips and salad.

recipes.name: Prawn & Mango Salad with Lime-Chilli Dressing
steps: Make the dressing: shake the lime, fish sauce, honey, chilli and oil in a jar.
Arrange the leaves, cucumber, onion, mango, avocado and prawns.
Drizzle with dressing just before serving.

recipes.name: Ricotta Hotcakes with Berry Compote
steps: Make the compote: simmer the berries, honey and lemon for 5 minutes until jammy.
Whisk the ricotta, yolks, milk and flour; fold in the stiffly beaten whites.
Cook spoonfuls in a lightly oiled pan for 2 minutes each side.
Stack and spoon over the warm compote.

recipes.name: Smoked Salmon Muffins with Dill Yoghurt
steps: Make the dill yoghurt: stir the yoghurt, lemon, dill and chopped capers.
Toast the muffins and poach the eggs.
Layer spinach, salmon and egg on the muffins and spoon over the yoghurt.

recipes.name: Eggs Benny with Yoghurt Hollandaise
steps: Make the hollandaise: whisk the yoghurt, yolk, mustard and lemon in a bowl over simmering water until thick and warm, then whisk in the butter.
Toast the muffins, warm the ham and wilt the spinach.
Poach the eggs for 3 minutes.
Stack and spoon over the sauce.

recipes.name: Homemade Baked Beans on Sourdough
steps: Make the sauce: soften the onion, then add the passata, tomato paste, sugar, soy, vinegar and paprika.
Add the beans and simmer 15 minutes until thick.
Stir through spinach and serve on toast.

recipes.name: Coconut Chia Pudding with Mango
steps: Whisk the chia, coconut milk, almond milk and maple; chill overnight.
Make the topping: toss the mango with lime.
Spoon the topping over the pudding and add pepitas.

recipes.name: Banana Bread Baked Oats
steps: Mix everything except the yoghurt topping; pour into 2 ramekins.
Bake at 180 °C for 22–25 minutes.
Make the maple yoghurt and spoon on top while warm.

recipes.name: Teriyaki Tofu Rice Bowl
steps: Make the teriyaki: simmer the soy, mirin, honey, ginger and cornflour slurry until glossy.
Toss the tofu in cornflour and air-fry or bake at 210 °C for 20 minutes.
Toss the tofu in the sauce.
Build bowls with rice, edamame, veg and tofu; top with sesame.

recipes.name: Tempeh Satay Noodle Salad
steps: Make the satay sauce: whisk everything in the sauce list with 3 tbsp hot water.
Pan-fry the tempeh until golden and toss in a spoonful of the sauce.
Toss the noodles and vegetables with the remaining sauce; top with tempeh and herbs.

recipes.name: Roast Pumpkin & Halloumi Salad
steps: Roast the pumpkin at 210 °C for 25 minutes.
Make the honey mustard dressing: shake the oil, vinegar, mustard and honey.
Massage the kale with a little dressing; grill the halloumi.
Toss everything with the quinoa, dressing and pepitas.

recipes.name: Paneer Tikka Masala
steps: Make the marinade and coat the paneer and capsicum; grill or air-fry until charred.
Make the masala sauce: soften the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil, add the spices, then passata; simmer 15 minutes and stir in the cream.
Fold the paneer through the sauce.
Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Goan Fish Curry
steps: Make the curry paste: blitz the chillies, garlic, ginger, spices, vinegar, tomato paste and onion.
Fry the paste for 3 minutes, then add the coconut milk and 100 ml water.
Simmer the fish in the sauce for 6–8 minutes and stir through the spinach.
Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Tandoori Chicken with Mint Raita
steps: Make the marinade and coat the chicken for at least 30 minutes.
Roast at 220 °C for 25 minutes until charred.
Make the raita: stir the yoghurt, chopped mint and grated cucumber.
Serve with rice, salad and raita.

recipes.name: Lighter Chicken Korma
steps: Make the korma sauce: soften the onion, garlic and ginger in the oil, add the spices, then blend with the cashews and stock until silky.
Simmer the chicken in the sauce for 12 minutes.
Off the heat stir in the yoghurt and peas.
Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Peri-Peri Chicken with Homemade Sauce
steps: Make the peri-peri sauce: blitz everything in the sauce list until smooth.
Coat the chicken in half the sauce and marinate 20 minutes.
Roast the chicken, potatoes and corn at 220 °C for 30 minutes.
Serve with salad and the remaining sauce.

recipes.name: Crunchy Peri-Peri Chickpeas
steps: Make the spice rub by mixing the spices and zest.
Toss the chickpeas in the oil and roast at 200 °C for 30 minutes.
Toss hot chickpeas in the rub; cool to crisp.

recipes.name: Tzatziki & Veggie Sticks
steps: Make the tzatziki: squeeze the cucumber dry and mix with the yoghurt, garlic, lemon and herbs.
Cut the vegetables and toast the pita.
Serve together.

recipes.name: Chilli Garlic Edamame
steps: Boil the edamame 4 minutes and drain.
Make the glaze: sizzle the garlic and chilli in the sesame oil, add soy and honey.
Toss the edamame in the glaze.

recipes.name: Beetroot Hummus with Pita Chips
steps: Make the dip: blitz everything in the dip list with 2–3 tbsp water until smooth.
Cut the pitas into wedges and bake at 200 °C for 8 minutes.
Serve the dip with the chips.

recipes.name: Guacamole & Baked Corn Chips
steps: Bake the tortilla wedges at 200 °C for 8 minutes.
Make the guacamole: mash the avocado with lime, then fold in the onion, coriander, chilli and tomato.
Serve with the chips.

recipes.name: Watermelon, Feta & Mint Salad
steps: Make the dressing: whisk the lime, honey and oil.
Arrange the watermelon, crumble over feta and mint.
Drizzle with dressing.

recipes.name: Chocolate Protein Mousse
steps: Whisk the yoghurt, cocoa, protein and maple until smooth and fluffy.
Spoon into glasses and chill.
Make the topping: scatter over the raspberries and grated dark chocolate just before serving.

recipes.name: Grilled Pineapple with Lime Yoghurt
steps: Make the glaze: mix the honey and cinnamon and brush over the pineapple.
Grill 2–3 minutes each side until caramelised.
Make the lime yoghurt and serve with the warm pineapple.

recipes.name: Apple Crumble Cups
steps: Cook the apple with cinnamon, honey and 2 tbsp water for 8 minutes; divide into 4 ramekins.
Make the crumble topping: rub the butter into the oats, almonds, flour and maple.
Scatter over the apple and bake at 190 °C for 20 minutes.
Serve with yoghurt.

recipes.name: Banana Nice-Cream with PB Choc Sauce
steps: Blitz the frozen banana with the milk until creamy.
Make the sauce: whisk the peanut butter, cocoa and maple with 2 tbsp hot water.
Scoop and drizzle with the sauce.

recipes.name: Date & Cashew Bliss Balls
steps: Blitz the dates, cashews, oats and cocoa until sticky.
Roll into 12 balls and coat in coconut.
Chill for 30 minutes. Keeps a week in the fridge.
